name: Four consecutive lower highs breakout reversal
author: u/Russ_CW
instruments_timeframes_claimed: US indices (index series); daily setup and same-day intraday execution
indicators: Count consecutive daily lower highs; trigger is latest high
entry_long: After >=4 consecutive lower highs, place buy stop at most recent high; gap above enters at open; if another lower high forms without trigger, update stop to new high.
entry_short: Short counterpart tested but not fully specified.
exit: Exit at close on entry day.
position_sizing: Split capital evenly among simultaneous index signals.
claimed_performance: Poster reports positive tests; self-reported, index proxies, fees/taxes omitted and fill assumptions optimistic.
implementation_notes: Define lower-high as today High < prior High; same-day stop and gap behavior require event-level data.
